LanguageData.PA_FaradayToggleDesc: Ground the eltex faraday cage. While grounded, psychic sensitivity is capped at 15% regardless of everything else — muting psychic drones, lances and hostile psycasts, but also crippling this pawn's own psycasting and eltex weaponry.
LanguageData.PA_AutoMendDesc: When enabled and assigned to Doctor work, this pawn will automatically seek out targets their attuned core can mend — injured colonists and animals with a water of tranquility core, damaged mechs with a mercury core — and treat them with eltex bolts. Buildings must always be targeted manually.
LanguageData.PA_VisionInspirationReason: {PAWN_labelShort}'s psychic reverie crystallized into sudden clarity.
LanguageData.PA_TraumaAwakeningText: {PAWN_labelShort}'s screams changed pitch halfway through the session. Something in {PAWN_possessive} mind has cracked open: {PAWN_pronoun} has gained a level of psylink.
LanguageData.PA_TraumaNoAwakening: {PAWN_labelShort} endured the hallucinations, but nothing awakened.
